kitEvidence.formula:
Heimerdinger upgrades his next non-ultimate Ability.

H-28Q Apex Turret: Place an upgraded Turret for 8 seconds that doesn't count towards Heimerdinger's max turrets, deals [80 / 100 / 120 + (0.35) × AP] magic damage per shot and [100 / 140 / 180 + (0.7) × AP] magic damage per charged shot. Its attacks deal damage in an area, Slow by 25% for 2 seconds, and it is immune to crowd control.

Hextech Rocket Swarm: Fires 4 waves of rockets that each deal [135 / 180 / 225 + (0.45) × AP] magic damage. Champions and jungle monsters hit by additional rockets take reduced damage, and minions take increased damage. Max Damage: [503 / 697.5 / 892 + (1.83) × AP] magic damage. 

CH-3X Lightning Grenade: Throws a bouncing grenade that discharges three times, dealing [100 / 200 / 300 + (0.6) × AP] magic damage. The Stun and Slow areas are larger.

Recast: Cancel this Ability.

builds.name: Micro-Rockets: five-rocket concentration
builds.summary: Investigate high one ordinary five-rocket volley on one champion output under a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high one ordinary five-rocket volley on one champion output under a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: The first rocket deals 50/75/100/125/150 + 0.55 AP magic; each additional champion hit uses 10/15/20/25/30 + 0.12 AP. Five hits therefore give rank-5 nominal 270 + 1.03 AP, matching the total helper rather than five full rockets.

ceiling.targetName: one ordinary five-rocket volley on one champion
ceiling.finiteState: Level 18, selected ability maximum learned rank unless explicitly overridden, minute 30. Enemy champion: 3000 maximum HP, 100 armor and 50 MR. Owner HP 100%, target HP 100%, observation 2s. No dragons, elixirs or allied stat buffs. Record actual AD/AP, HP and resist modifiers; Gathering Storm at minute 30 if selected. No free permanent stacks. Stop damage at death, cap healing at recipient missing HP, and report raw output separately. Seraph transformed. Ordinary W with R upgrade inactive, five rockets all connect with one isolated champion in a two-second observation. No turrets are firing at the scored victim; their charge gained from rocket hits does not enter the W-only result.
